eia-ercot-2021.json.notes: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration. Historical revised values; not archived publication vintages. UTC hour ending. Null values retained. API length<=5000 with offset pagination.

eia-ercot-2021-fuels.json.notes: All returned fuel types; missing values remain null. Fuel groups are not individual plant telemetry.

texas-county-outages.json.notes: Jikun Liu, 4TU.ResearchData, version 1. All 28,448 county/time records retained (254 counties, 112 three-hour timestamps, Feb 11-24 2021). Only county, time, outage_count and temp retained; numeric values preserved. Source DATASETS.md states timestamps are naive, with no timezone specified; do not label them UTC or align to EIA without verification. It calls outage_count outages/events, without confirming customers. Temperature is described only as degrees; Celsius/Fahrenheit is not specified. No unit conversion or imputation.

texas-counties.geojson.notes: U.S. Census Bureau cb_2020_us_county_20m, all 254 Texas counties (STATEFP 48). Source is already generalized to 1:20,000,000. Retained GEOID, NAME, STATEFP, and all polygon vertices, rounded to 4 decimal places; rings reversed to GeoJSON exterior orientation. NAD83 longitude/latitude treated as WGS84 at this display scale; no datum transform. Not for engineering measurements.

flint-samples.json.license: No explicit reuse license stated in the source workbook or download page; public research data, attribution retained.
flint-samples.json.notes: Virginia Tech FlintWaterStudy team and Flint residents. 271 included rows from 'Samples from Flint Water homes'; excluded-sample/comparison worksheets and names omitted. Zip is text; duplicate SampleIDs retained. Pb1/2/3 are ppb at first draw/45-second flush/2-minute flush. Values below 1 ppb are below the stated detection limit; do not treat them as precise measurements. Numeric XML cache binary artifacts rounded to 12 decimals. No per-sample dates are supplied; no admission-date comparison is inferred.

hubei-cases.json.notes: COVID-19 Data Repository by the Center for Systems Science and Engineering (CSSE) at Johns Hopkins University (https://github.com/CSSEGISandData/COVID-19). Hubei/China row only, all source dates preserved. Cumulative confirmed cases; source revisions/decreases retained. Cite Dong E, Du H, Gardner L, Lancet Infect Dis 20(5):533–534, doi:10.1016/S1473-3099(20)30120-1. This is the final revised historical series, not vintage data as known each day.

wuhan-early-points.json.license: Hand-entered factual numbers with citations; source text remains under each publisher's terms. No general dataset reuse license asserted for NHC, WHO or Imperial reports.
wuhan-early-points.json.notes: Three distinct cited points: Wuhan MHC 59 unexplained-pneumonia cases Jan5 (verified via NHC retrospective timeline); WHO41 confirmed reported Jan11–12; Imperial Report1 published Jan17 estimates1723 symptom onsets byJan12 (95%CI427–4471). Case definitions, event dates, publication dates and geography are distinct. Imperial abstract verified on official publication listing; report landing page returned403 during retrieval.
